name: What amenities should be included in an in-law suite?
description: An in-law suite should include a private bedroom, bathroom, living area, and potentially a kitchenette or full kitchen, with accessibility features considered.

mainEntity.name: What amenities should be included in an in-law suite?

acceptedAnswer.text: Essential amenities for an in-law suite typically include a private bedroom, a full bathroom, and a functional living area. Depending on the intended use and local regulations, a kitchenette with a sink, mini-fridge, and microwave, or a full kitchen, may also be included. Homeowners should consider the long-term needs of the occupants; for example, ensuring accessibility features are integrated during the design phase for aging family members is a practical tradeoff that adds future value.
acceptedAnswer.description: An in-law suite should include a private bedroom, bathroom, living area, and potentially a kitchenette or full kitchen, with accessibility features considered.
